title: Digital Me Project
summary: An AI-powered Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform that lets users upload personal documents and interact with them conversationally using grounded AI responses.
role: Designed and developed the complete full-stack architecture, including frontend experience, AI retrieval pipeline, backend APIs, and vector search integration.
key_impact: Built an end-to-end conversational AI system capable of semantic search across uploaded documents.
Implemented chunking, embeddings, context re-ranking, and caching to improve retrieval accuracy and reduce hallucinations.
Optimized repeated query performance with intelligent caching and source-aware response generation.
Developed scalable streaming-based AI responses for improved user experience and lower perceived latency.

sections.heading: What It Does
sections.body: Digital Me is an AI-powered Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform that lets users upload personal documents and interact with them conversationally using grounded AI responses.

sections.heading: Role
sections.body: Designed and developed the complete full-stack architecture, including the frontend experience, AI retrieval pipeline, backend APIs, and vector search integration.

sections.heading: Tech Stack
sections.body: Next.js 14, TypeScript, FastAPI, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, Pinecone, Tailwind CSS, SSE Streaming.

sections.heading: Key Impact
sections.body: Built an end-to-end conversational AI system, improved retrieval accuracy with chunking and re-ranking, optimized repeated queries with caching, and delivered scalable streaming responses.
